content.title: Yaxel Lendeborg 2026 NBA Mock Draft Prediction for Michigan Star F
content.text: The No. 1 seed Michigan Wolverines have rolled through the 2026 NCAA Tournament, winning their games by an average margin of +22.5 points per matchup. The Wolverines face Arizona in the national semifinal on Saturday, April 4, at 8:49 p.m. ET on TBS, truTV, and HBO Max. Reigning Big Ten Player of the Year, Michigan F Yaxel Lendeborg has dominated the postseason, impacting both sides of the floor while touting elite efficiency. Lendeborg was viewed as a promising 2026 NBA Draft prospect for most of the season, and he’s further helped his stock of late.Let’s make a Yaxel Lendeborg 2026 NBA Mock Draft prediction, including his draft payouts and projections on PrizePicks Team Picks. Yaxel Lendeborg Scouting Report: Breaking Down Michigan’s NCAA Tournament StarAfter totaling 17.7 points per game (PPG) and 11.4 rebounds per game (RPG) at UAB in the 2024-25 season, Lendeborg was a borderline NBA first-round pick for the 2025 class. Instead, he elected to come back to school and was ranked as the top available 2025 college basketball transfer, per 247 Sports.Yaxel has flourished in his move to a high-major program, leading Michigan with 15.2 PPG, while his 7.0 RPG ranks second. Furthermore, he’s provided 1.2 steals and 1.3 blocks per game, contributing to his elite 5.52 Defensive Bayesian Performance Rating (first nationally), per EvanMiya.He’s taken his production a step further in the NCAA Tournament, logging 21.0 PPG and 7.3 RPG. Lendeborg’s been an efficient three-level scorer all season, proven by his 52.0% field goal percentage and 37.2% mark from deep. Over four NCAA Tournament games, the UAB transfer has shot a mind-boggling 59.2% from the field and 50.0% on 3-pointers.Yaxel is flirting with a lottery pick, the top 14 selections, in the 2026 NBA Draft. Where could he land in June’s draft?Yaxel Lendeborg 2026 NBA Mock Draft Prediction & Best Team FitsAccording to Tankathon’s 2026 NBA Draft Big Board, Lendeborg currently ranks 12th overall in the loaded class. Kevin O’Connor of Yahoo Sports projected Yaxel to the Charlotte Hornets with the 16th pick. In Adam Finelstein of CBS Sports’ 2026 NBA Mock Draft, Lendeborg was also slotted 16th overall, but this time to the Memphis Grizzlies.If Lendeborg was selected 12th overall, in line with his Tankathon big board ranking, he would land with the Oklahoma City Thunder. While the Michigan superstar has all the makings of an exceptional NBA wing, he turns 24 in September. PrizePicks Team Picks has payouts for Lendeborg to be a top 3, top 5, or top 10 pick in the 2026 NBA Draft.Top 3: Yes 22.22xTop 5: Yes 16.66xTop 10: Yes 2.85x | No 1.35xWith most big boards and mock drafts projecting Lendeborg to fall within the first 16 picks, crashing the top 10 may be within reach.Yaxel Lendeborg Best NBA Team FitsAs mentioned, the Thunder are in position to pick 12th overall in the 2026 NBA Draft. This feels like a near-perfect fit for Lendeborg.His all-around skillset and veteran experience could provide Oklahoma City with a “win now” piece off the bench. Plus, Lendeborg’s three-level scoring and elite defense provide real upside to develop into a starter.The Thunder are currently chasing their second consecutive NBA title, featuring a 2.43x payout for “Yes” to win the 2026 NBA Finals, per PrizePicks Team Picks.Tankathon also tabs the Milwaukee Bucks (10th) and the Golden State Warriors (11th) with top-12 selections. Lendeborg could fill each team’s long-term need for a starting small forward. Plus, his ability to play power forward would align with the Warriors’ small-ball tactics.Make 2026 NBA Draft Predictions on PrizePicks Lendeborg can further boost his NBA Draft stock under the spotlight of Saturday’s NCAA Tournament national semifinal.
